subject.title: Prompt-cache prefix churn on OpenAI models: per-turn dynamic injections (message tool hint + volatile system-prompt section) defeat automatic prefix caching

question: Should `message_tool_only` visible-reply guidance be moved out of OpenAI/Codex tool schemas and system-prompt prefix content even if that changes the current prompt-steering contract?
rationale: The cache contract strongly favors stable tool/system prefixes, but the existing conditional hint is also part of visible reply delivery reliability, so automation should not choose the final owner boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Move volatile guidance late
options.body: Make the message tool schema stable and inject turn-specific delivery guidance into user/runtime context after the stable prefix, then prove delivery and OpenAI cache behavior.

options.title: Keep schema steering
options.body: Leave the current conditional tool/system guidance in place and accept the documented OpenAI cache cost for stronger visible-reply steering.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Pause implementation until a maintainer reruns current-main OpenAI telemetry to confirm which remaining prefix bytes still churn.

recommendation.title: Move volatile guidance late
recommendation.body: Make the message tool schema stable and inject turn-specific delivery guidance into user/runtime context after the stable prefix, then prove delivery and OpenAI cache behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent area metadata make this the best available routing candidate for the affected prompt/tool surfaces.
